title: Apple faces another App Store antitrust fight, this time in Chile
summary: Apple is facing renewed pressure to open its iOS ecosystem as Chile pushes for alternative app stores and payment systems. Chile seeks $80 million fine over Apple's iOS restrictions On Friday, Chile's competition regulator asked the country's antitrust court to fine Apple approximately $80 million over alleged anticompetitive practices. The regulator also seeks corrective measures addressing Apple's restrictions on app distribution and in-app payments on iOS. Reuters reports Chile's National Economic Prosecutor's Office (FNE) alleges Apple has restricted competition in both areas since at least 2019. The proposed fine is equal to 30% of sales from products and services linked to the alleged violations during the investigated period. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

title: How to set up your own Hotline server for macOS in 2026
summary: Hotline is a familiar name to old-school Mac users, and it has been resurrected by a series of new projects. Here's how to set up a server on your Mac, and keep the service running safely. Hotline was a community file-sharing ecosystem of yesteryear Social media is an ever-evolving landscape, with services quickly coming to life and just as quickly disappearing once better options become available. However, before everyone got infatuated with Facebook and MySpace, there were much smaller communities and other technologies at play. Before modern-day social media, chat services dominated, and predating those were things like bulletin board systems (BBS), forums, chat clients like Internet Relay Chat (IRC) and AOL Instant Messenger (AIM).
